name: Content slide with navigator
purpose: To present detailed text content while indicating the current progress or phase within a larger process.
use_when: Use when providing detailed explanations or instructions that are part of a multi-step sequence.
avoid_when: Avoid when the slide requires heavy data visualization, multiple columns, or large imagery.
notes: The layout includes a specific area for a progress navigator (chevrons) in the top right.
